title: Assassin armor
wikitext:
{{TOCright}}
A full set of [[Assassin]] armor consists of a mask, guise, gloves, leggings and shoes.

==Armor bonuses==
[[Basic armor|Basic]] Assassin armor provides up to a maximum of 70 [[Armor rating|armor]], 5 extra energy and 2 extra [[energy recovery]].

Other [[armor bonus]]es are available on top of these basic stats either as an attribute bonus, an [[insignia#Assassin|insignia]], or a [[rune]].
